title: cards
subtitle: THREE LABELS::CONFIRMED=Rockstar said it|PREVIEWS=People who played preview builds|MY GUESS=I say so out loud

narration: If Rockstar said it themselves, I will tell you it is confirmed.
If it comes from people who saw the preview builds, I will say previewers reported it.
And if it is just me guessing, I will say so out loud.
After going through everything, one pattern jumped out at me, and I will give it to you at the end, because it changes how you should play every single region.
First, the size.
title: THE SIZE
subtitle: Bigger than anything Rockstar has built

narration: Rockstar North's Aaron Garbut told Game Informer this is the biggest map the studio has ever built, by a clear margin, roughly double GTA 5.
title: quote
subtitle: ROCKSTAR NORTH::The biggest map the studio has ever built|Aaron Garbut|Game Informer

narration: Then Rockstar gave Edge a different comparison, saying Leonida's landmass is close to GTA 4, GTA 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2 added together.
title: cards
subtitle: TWO COMPARISONS::GAME INFORMER=About double GTA V|EDGE=GTA IV + GTA V + RDR2 combined

narration: Those two comparisons do not match perfectly, and Rockstar has never published a number in kilometers, so any exact figure you see online is a fan estimate.
title: NO OFFICIAL KM
subtitle: ANY EXACT NUMBER = FAN ESTIMATE

narration: What Edge did say is that a full in-game day lasts much longer than in GTA 5, and the roads are narrower, which makes everything feel packed.
title: checklist
subtitle: EDGE/WHY IT FEELS PACKED::A LONGER IN-GAME DAY THAN GTA V|NARROWER ROADS

narration: And a Rockstar narrative lead admitted there is not enough time to walk you through every corner.
Play only the story missions and parts of that map will stay black.
title: STORY ONLY = STILL BLACK

narration: So let us light it up, starting where the game starts.
The Leonida Keys, Rockstar's version of the Florida Keys, long bridges with water on both sides.
title: LEONIDA KEYS
subtitle: Region 1  ·  the rule: money

narration: Previews say this is where Jason's story begins, and here is a detail I love.
His home is not even his.
It belongs to Brian Heder, an old school smuggler who runs a boat yard with his third wife, Lori, and he lets Jason stay for free as long as Jason helps with some local work.
title: Brian Heder
subtitle: Old-school smuggler | Runs a boat yard with his third wife, Lori. Jason stays free for local work.

narration: That is the most Florida rental deal I have ever heard.
Now the part the trailers skipped.
title: THE SECRET BASE
subtitle: PREVIEWS  ·  NOT SHOWN YET

place: Military Base=far end of the Keys@24.56,-81.78

title: FORT ZANCUDO

narration: You know exactly where I am steering my first car.
The water here is beautiful, but it is crowded.

They would not say.
My guess is Burmese pythons.

Inland sits Ambrosia, and its official description is my favorite on the entire site.
The Allied Crystal Sugar refinery provides the jobs, and the local biker gang provides almost everything else.

Some bank money shows up as marked cash, so you need a special buyer to clean it.
For cars, an app called WAINK shows what fences want, how well a car is protected, and whether it has a tracker.

In 1938 a tour boat operator, Colonel Tooey, released a few on an island to make his jungle cruise more exciting.
title: HOW FLORIDA GOT MONKEYS
subtitle: 1938=Colonel Tooey releases a few on an island; SAME YEAR=His jungle cruise gets wilder; ALMOST AT ONCE=They swim away

narration: They swam away almost immediately.
So here is my theory.
title: MY THEORY
subtitle: NOT IN THE KEYS

narration: If Rockstar copied real Florida, Leonida's monkeys are not in the Keys.
They are inland, somewhere between Ambrosia and Kalaga.

Ocean Beach has pastel Art Deco hotels.

One last thing to watch is the sky.
Game Informer confirmed tropical storms and hurricanes, though Rockstar has not said how often they hit.
title: REAL FLORIDA HURRICANES

narration: And the map is not just bigger outside.
Aaron Garbut told Edge there is an order of magnitude more interiors, which literally means about ten times more doors you can open.
title: stats
subtitle: AARON GARBUT · EDGE::10x=more interiors|MORE=doors you can open

narration: The weather also moves across the map.
Edge says wind, humidity, fog, time of day, even the season all shape it.
title: checklist
subtitle: EDGE/WHAT SHAPES THE WEATHER::WIND|HUMIDITY|FOG|TIME OF DAY|THE SEASON

narration: After rain, the roads stay wet and dry at different speeds.
People on the street run for cover.
Boats rock on the waves, and small planes get tossed around and can take minor damage in a bad storm.
So yes, flying straight into a hurricane is on my list.
